2.5 km takeaway micro market

Geethanjali Junction, Mayoori Building, near HP Petrol Pump, Ponnurunni, Vyttila, Ernakulam 682032 is the subject property address on the report's map. The radius covers residential, commercial, transit and retail catchments in all directions.

North · Vyttila Junction & Ponnurunni

0–1 km core zone
  • High footfall and commuter movement
  • Good for quick-service meals, bakery, tea and juice
  • Established commercial activity area

East / Northeast · Janatha Junction

0.5–1.5 km zone
  • Cafes, bakeries, snacks and dessert options
  • Examples: Mel B's, Cake Hut Vyttila
  • Suitable for burgers, sandwiches, cakes, desserts

South / Southeast · Thykoodam & Poonithura

1–2.5 km zone
  • Residential neighbourhoods
  • Budget meals, homely food, biryani, tea
  • More suited to delivery-led formats

Southwest · Kundannoor / Maradu approach

About 2–2.5 km, outer catchment
  • Bypass visibility and vehicle access
  • Parking and pickup convenience
  • Nearby: Forum Mall Kochi, organised retail and food

West / Northwest · SA Road & Vyttila streets

Inner to middle catchment
  • Breakfast, vegetarian meals, coffee, snacks
  • Easy stopping and pickup for commuters

Vyttila, Ponnurunni and Janatha Junction are the prime F&B zones. Outer-ring areas such as Kundannoor, Maradu and Thykoodam add volume for delivery-led and takeaway formats.
